name: Guerrilla Graphix
old_description: Guerrilla Graphix is a small business located in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the heart of the Nob Hill district. We offer a diverse selection of over 1,000 gift items available for both retail and wholesale customers. Our prices are competitive, and we provide a variety of services, including graphic design, custom screen printing, embroidery, and large-format digital printing. Stop by and check us out!
about:
Guerrilla Graphix operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the city's Nob Hill district. The small business offers a diverse selection of over 1,000 gift items for retail and wholesale customers, alongside custom printing and design services.

The company provides graphic design, branding, pre-press layout, and logo development, and produces custom screen printing, embroidery, and large-format digital printing on apparel such as T-shirts, hoodies, hats, bandanas, aprons, tote bags, team jerseys, and uniforms. It also runs an online store featuring pop-culture and New Mexico-themed merchandise, and offers wholesale contract printing services for resellers.

Customers include retail shoppers, wholesale buyers, and organizations seeking custom branded apparel. The wholesale program supplies giftware and apparel to resellers, while the contract printing side serves teams, businesses, and local groups needing uniforms or promotional items.

Guerrilla Graphix emphasizes original, often humorous or topical designs that "catch the eye, push the envelope, and pull the leg," spanning artistic, political, historical, and regional themes. Competitive pricing and in-house production are noted as part of its approach.

name: H P Electronics
old_description: Joe has been working professionally with audio, video and related systems since 1988. Starting as a guitar accessory salesman at a large Musical Instrument Retailer, Joe advanced to become the Department Head of the Drum Section and then the Pro Sound Division. This experience led him in 1998 to HP Electronics, Inc. and the installation side of Audio and Video, where he has learned the sophisticated needs and techniques of designing and implementing professional, commercial grade AV. As a working musician, sound person and project studio owner, Joe understands the aspects of theater and house of worship presentations beyond his design and installation work at HP, offering additional guidance to his clients. Outside of work and music, Joe enjoys sports, especially baseball and hockey, the outdoors and spending time with his wife and 2 kids.
about:
HP Electronics, Inc. was established in 1983 in Baltimore, Maryland, as a licensed electrical contractor specializing in low-voltage electronic systems, distribution sub-systems, and fiber-optic transport media. The company has grown into a provider of professional sound, video, communication, and integrated control systems.

The firm designs and installs audio systems, area-of-rescue emergency communication, classroom AV, synchronized clock and timekeeping networks, control system integration, digital signage, and campus-wide intercom and paging. Its project portfolio spans nationwide and overseas; the company notes that it designed and installed one of the first modern sound systems on mainland China. Over 75 percent of new business comes from client referrals.

HP Electronics serves education, healthcare, corporate and commercial, government and public sector, houses of worship, entertainment venues, retail, and hospitality. Recent projects include the New Severn Run High School auditorium and stadium, and the Church of the Resurrection.

The company states its founding philosophy centers on making client satisfaction the most important product it delivers, aiming to be the most sought-after electronic systems contractor through a pledge of high-level design, installation, and service that earns referrals.

name: H S Automotive Alabama Inc
old_description: Hwaseung's auto parts business group is strengthening its overseas expansion, focusing on overseas subsidiaries in the U.S., China, India, Europe, and South America, while maintaining its No. 1 domestic market share in Korea.
about:
H S Automotive Alabama Inc operates from Enterprise, Alabama, as a U.S. subsidiary of South Korea's Hwaseung Group, a major automotive parts supplier that holds the number one domestic market share in Korea. The Alabama location is part of Hwaseung's overseas expansion strategy, which includes subsidiaries in China, India, Europe, and South America.

The facility produces two core product lines: weather strips, which are rubber sealing components that fit between vehicle body panels, and automotive hoses for engine, brake, and air-conditioning fluid systems. Hwaseung attributes its sealing performance to a proprietary rubber mixing technology, while its hose line is backed by continuous R&D investment.

The company serves the automotive industry, supplying original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers globally. Its customer base includes automakers in the United States and other markets where Hwaseung has established a local presence.

Hwaseung states that its competitive edge comes from global localization, active R&D spending, and a push to rank among the world's top three automotive sealing and fluid-system suppliers.

name: H&H Metal Fabrication
old_description: Engineering teams, project managers, and procurement buyers trust H&H to take a tight spec and fabricate it into something that ships when we say it will. St. Louis-based, serving customers across the region and beyond since 1947.
about:
H&H Metal Fabrication operates from St. Louis, Missouri. The company traces its roots to 1947 when the Finazzo family began manufacturing light fixtures in the same building as the H&H radio shop. It has remained family-owned for over 79 years. In 2019, ownership transitioned to Carolyn Farrell (President) and Morgan Jarrett (COO), making it a certified women-owned business (WBENC). Kevin Farrell serves as CFO.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication built to print, including electrical enclosures, e-houses (large-scale electrical structures), custom fabricated components, panels, supports, assemblies, and specialty metal products. They also offer enclosure modification services such as cut-outs, drilling, threading, and panel changes. Their downtown plant houses a 500-ton, 22-foot press brake, indicating heavy forming capacity. They provide full painting capabilities and consultations at any design stage. No specific headcount or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers include engineering teams, project managers, procurement buyers, electrical contractors, manufacturers, and designers. Concrete examples: Villa Lighting Supply Inc. (lighting projects in the US and Canada), Missouri Botanical Garden (Chihuly Blue Chandelier reinstallation attachment mechanism), and St. Louis City Hall (exterior lighting housings). They serve industries such as lighting, electrical contracting, construction, and general manufacturing.

The company emphasizes integrity, collaboration, quality, and innovation as core values. They highlight "St. Louis-made, shipped wherever the work needs to go" and a commitment to highest industry standards and first-class customer service. The women-owned certification provides a procurement advantage for customers with supplier diversity requirements.

name: HB Specialty Foods
old_description: Our Turnkey Solutions Simplify Your Business. Your focus should be on making the connections that will land your product into YOUR customer’s hands — and here is how HB can help.
about:
HB Specialty Foods operates from Nampa, Idaho, with additional manufacturing facilities in Boise, Idaho; Beloit, Wisconsin; and Cookeville, Tennessee. The company traces its roots to developing high-performance coating systems for the food industry, a foundation that later expanded into a full suite of turnkey services for food manufacturers.

The company provides end-to-end solutions including custom product development, co-packing, contract dry blending, specialty coating systems (batters and breaders), specialty packaging, and supply chain management. It runs three manufacturing facilities with specialty segregated lines to prevent allergen cross-contamination, and maintains connections to over 20,000 acres of growers in the Pacific Northwest for conventional, organic, biodynamic, and regenerative crops. Its fulfillment and logistics team brings more than 30 years of experience, and the firm has helped hundreds of clients scale from small-batch to high-volume production.

HB Specialty Foods serves food manufacturers and brand owners seeking to bring cleaner-label, natural, and innovative products to market. Its customers range from startups needing formulation and scale-up support to established brands requiring regulatory compliance, certification support, and global ingredient procurement.

The company differentiates itself through its integrated turnkey model — spanning R&D, sourcing, manufacturing, compliance, and logistics — and its early leadership in coating technology, which it leverages to develop craveable, better-for-you products. Specialty segregated facilities and direct farmer relationships further distinguish its offering.

name: HC Group Auto Parts Supply LLC - Columbia

about:
HC Group Auto Parts Supply operates from Columbia, South Carolina, where it has served the automotive aftermarket since 2005. The business is family-owned and emphasizes its local roots across the Midlands and Lowcountry regions.

The company stocks a complete line of premium aftermarket auto body parts, including bumpers, lighting, mirrors, and related components. It carries the same brands and part numbers distributed by LKQ Keystone, and advertises that its inventory is available for immediate pickup at its Columbia location. Delivery service extends to body shops and repair facilities throughout central and eastern South Carolina, as well as the Augusta, Georgia area.

Primary customers are collision repair centers, auto body shops, and mechanical repair shops in the listed delivery regions — Columbia, Lexington, Cayce, Irmo, West Columbia, Sumter, Florence, Orangeburg, Charleston, and surrounding communities. The supplier positions itself as a local alternative to national distributors, offering stocked parts without wait times.

HC Group highlights several differentiators: family ownership since 2005, a “great price guaranteed” pledge, and access to parts from vendors it describes as the “World’s #1 Bumper Manufacturer” and a top lighting and mirror supplier. The company also notes that many of the parts it sells are made in the USA.

name: HME Specialists
old_description: I have been using oxygen since 2001 and have been with other providers until last year. The service I have received from HME has bee far superior to other companies. Every HME person I have dealt with, whether in person, or over the phone, has bee professional, courteous and most of all helpful.
about:
HME Specialists is headquartered in Santa Fe, New Mexico. The company was founded in 2001 by four New Mexicans who aimed to create a locally owned medical equipment supplier that could match the product breadth of national chains while delivering a higher standard of personalized service. Today, the firm describes itself as New Mexico's largest local medical equipment and supply company.

The business provides a range of home medical equipment and clinical services, including home oxygen therapy, breast pumps, sleep therapy (CPAP/BiPAP), home infusion therapy, enteral nutrition, wound care, and incontinence and urology supplies. It coordinates with patients' insurance carriers and healthcare providers to handle delivery and setup, and employs a clinical staff that includes pharmacists, registered nurses, assistive technology professionals (ATPs), and respiratory therapists. Operations span multiple locations across the state, such as Farmington, Las Cruces, Roswell, and Albuquerque.

The company serves patients requiring durable medical equipment at home, as well as healthcare providers, hospice agencies, and insurance payers. Concrete examples from customer testimonials include long-term oxygen users, CPAP patients transitioning equipment, pediatric tracheostomy and ventilator-dependent children, and hospice patients needing urgent DME delivery for end-of-life care at home.

The founders' stated vision was to offer the same level of medical equipment as larger national suppliers but with a higher standard of personalized, local service. The company highlights its clinical team's expertise and its community partnerships with organizations such as the American Lung Association and the American Heart Association as key differentiators.

name: HPP Food Services - Wilmington
old_description: HPP Food Services helps natural food and beverage companies high pressure process without compromise.
about:
HPP Food Services operates from Wilmington, California, providing high pressure processing (HPP) services to natural food and beverage companies. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it positions itself as a partner for brands seeking to extend shelf life without preservatives.

The facility offers high pressure processing for a wide range of products including juices, smoothies, guacamole, salsa, meats, ready-to-eat meals, meal trays, spouted pouches, wet salads, dressings, dips, soups, hummus, snack packs, cream and dairy spreads, sauces, purees, baby food, and pet food. Beyond processing, the company provides consultation calls, packaging guidance, lab test coordination, and HACCP plan integration, with support from Avure scientists for formulation questions.

Customers are natural food and beverage manufacturers across categories such as juice and beverage producers, meat processors, ready-to-eat meal makers, baby food brands, and pet food companies. The service is aimed at brands that want to maintain clean-label appeal while achieving food safety and longer shelf life.

The company emphasizes a trusting partnership and a flexible operating environment, maintaining high operational standards so customers can grow. Its operations team works alongside Avure scientists to deliver expertise and support through each step, from packaging to lab testing and HACCP compliance.

about:
HTS Fabrication, Inc. was founded in 1993 in Lakeville, Minnesota. The company operates as a solutions provider specializing in custom metal fabrication using aluminum and carbon steel to address production equipment issues and capital equipment needs.

The shop offers engineering and machine design, custom metal fabrication, machine assembly, material handling systems, and enamel and epoxy painting. Work ranges from simple components to complex capital equipment, built from customer prints or developed from concept through research and development.

Customers include large manufacturers such as 3M, B&G Foods, Toro, and Crenlo, for whom HTS builds production equipment, material handling products, and ergonomic manufacturing facilities. The company serves industries that require one-of-a-kind manufacturing and material handling solutions to improve production flow and employee safety.

HTS emphasizes its ability to create custom products not found in catalogs, backed by fast turnaround times and direct, one-on-one client collaboration to increase production efficiency.
